Keep reminders reliable on aggressive devices

Some phone brands (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and others) stop apps in the background. If reminders arrive late:

1. Open system settings for CatatKu.
2. Allow notifications and exact alarms.
3. Set battery usage to unrestricted.
4. Lock the app in the recent apps screen if your phone supports it.
CatatKu needs notification permission so task deadlines, bills, and budget alerts can reach you. Reminders are scheduled on your device and work offline.
